prometheus/queries.json: the exact PromQL, step and window of every series, with how each was collected, and each optional catalog's detection result.

## Definitions

### timeWindow

A UTC range query window.

| Field   | Type                                                    | Required | Description |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `start` | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp) | Yes      |             |
| `end`   | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp) | Yes      |             |

### queryResult

collected: series returned. empty: the query ran and returned nothing. error: the query failed.

Type: `"collected"`, `"empty"`, `"error"`

### query

| Field          | Type                                                              | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `catalog`      | [catalogName](/reference/schemas/common/#catalogname)             | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `name`         | [metricName](/reference/schemas/common/#metricname)               | Yes      | Series name; the raw result is prometheus/&lt;catalog&gt;/&lt;name&gt;.json.                                                                            |
| `query`        | `string`                                                          | Yes      | The PromQL exactly as sent.                                                                                                                             |
| `step_seconds` | `number`                                                          | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                                                                                                                  |
| `window`       | [timeWindow](/reference/schemas/prometheus-queries/#timewindow)   | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `result`       | [queryResult](/reference/schemas/prometheus-queries/#queryresult) | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `may_be_empty` | `boolean`                                                         | No       | The catalog declares an empty result normal for this series, such as no CPU limit, no HPA or no GPU, so an empty result is not counted as missing data. |
| `detail`       | `string`                                                          | No       | Required when result is error: what failed.                                                                                                             |

### catalogResult

collected: detected and queried. absent: not detected on this cluster. error: detection or a query failed.

Type: `"collected"`, `"absent"`, `"error"`
